verdict.rationale: Riskified ingests device and session data through its own Beacon (web JS and Android) linked by session ID. Merchants send order and transaction data via /decide and /submit. Plaid account data can be added, and Riskified's analytics team calibrates models per account during onboarding. However, there is no evidence that developers can supply their own device fingerprints or arbitrary custom metadata fields that the model then weights. Missing for 10: documented custom-field or merchant-signal ingestion, ability to bring third-party or own device fingerprints, developer-controlled influence on scoring, independent corroboration.
